Presence | > 🗡 **Voracious Mastication ([Signature Ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability))** > > | **Melee, Strike, Weapon** | **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |---------------------------|--------------------------------:| > | **📏 Melee 1** | **🎯 Two creatures or objects** | > > **Power Roll + 3:** > > - **≤11:** 10 damage > - **12-16:** 15 damage; M < 2 [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends) > - **17+:** 18 damage; M < 3 [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends) > > **1 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice):** The glutton regains [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) equal to the damage dealt. > 👤 **Crash Through (3 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))** > > | **-** | **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |-------------|----------------:| > | **📏 Self** | **🎯 Self** | > > **Effect:** The glutton [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed in a straight line, ignoring [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain). The first time during this movement that the glutton moves through the space of a creature or object their size or smaller, that creature or object takes 10 damage, or a creature can choose to fall [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) instead. If the glutton moves into a creature or object larger than them and doesn't knock the creature [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) or destroy the object, the glutton's movement ends and they are [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) until the end of their next turn. > 👤 **Food Frenzy** > > | **-** | **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |-------------|-------------:| > | **📏 Self** | **🎯 Self** | > > **Effect:** Until the start of their next turn, the glutton has a double edge on strikes, and strikes made against them gain an edge. > ❗️ **Spiteful Retort (1 [Malice](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/malice))** > > | **Melee** | **Free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action)** | > |----------------|-------------------------------:| > | **📏 Melee 1** | **🎯 The triggering creature** | > > **Trigger:** The glutton is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) but doesn't die. > > **Effect:** The glutton uses Voracious Mastication against an [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) creature. > ⭐️ **Insatiable Appetite** > > Once per turn, the glutton can use the Charge main action as a free maneuver if they target a [winded](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/winded) creature. > ⭐️ **Relentless Hunger** > > The glutton dies only if they are reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), or if they take acid or fire damage while at 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina).
